claims.does_not_prove: Retraction does not itself show every behavioral/connectomic observation is false or independently accepted.

claims.claim: The E16 T cell has a recurrent multiplicatively gated hidden state h_t=r_t*h_(t-1)+w_t*c_t; w=1-r in single-gate configuration.
claims.does_not_prove: Reconfigurable abstract working memory or a Drosophila CX compass

claims.claim: Recurrence-dependent synapse eligibility traces and supervised readout loss gradients are composed to produce local parameter gradients; network still receives externally generated correct answer bytes.
claims.does_not_prove: Self-generated reinforcement prediction error or biological synaptic locality end-to-end

claims.claim: SignLinear uses dynamic S=sign(weight)*mean(abs(weight)) in backward pass, not fixed random feedback.
claims.does_not_prove: Exact transposed feedback or independently generated local learning signal

claims.claim: Replay stores structured (family,task,operands) items, re-renders prompts and computes correct composition/single-op targets via helper arithmetic; historical control is not raw-stream replay.
claims.does_not_prove: Learner acquired its own task parser or oracle-free synthetic replay

claims.claim: E4 C stores prompts in an exact-match logit memory and regenerates replay labels from its own outputs, with fallback 00 EOS on malformed outputs; Cs has random targets.
claims.does_not_prove: Safe self-generated replay under interference

claims.claim: Pinned E16V read-only audit confirms source/receipts with discrepancies; uniform E16W replay late-stage composition targets wrong 13.59–21.40% on full target and 11.29–18.88% on final target. C_share target correctness was not saved.
claims.does_not_prove: Coverage is the only cause; correctness for C_share is unknown

claims.claim: 12/12 E16W2 jobs complete. Uniform local old composition loss 45.58/46.42/48.08pp; equal replay-batch BP matched control also loses 44.17/42.25/38.92pp. Share improves 6.25/10.88/8.17pp, below preregistered 1/3 loss reduction.
claims.does_not_prove: The replay target quality issue alone explains all losses

claims.claim: Adult FlyWire v630 CX fitted combined heading-goal steering passed 3/3 revised gates; fitted native 79/96 combined vs rewired 21–22/96 with 15 fitted scalars reported.
claims.does_not_prove: Learns arbitrary goals or solves path integration

claims.claim: Path integration failed qualification gates in all 3 seeds despite native vector-direction advantage; follow-up says wiring gives instantaneous vector while temporal accumulation is supplied by model, and return failure persists with true-heading clamp.
claims.does_not_prove: General failure of vector computation; failure is model/path-integration package

shortlist.name: Target provenance and replay scaffolding (NOT a new biological F mechanism)
shortlist.observed_limitation: E16V uniform replay contains 13.59–21.40% wrong full composition targets late; E16W both local learner and same-batch BP lose old task accuracy.
shortlist.new_capability: Causally trustworthy rehearsal and raw-sequence training without task/operand oracle, if possible.
shortlist.missing_or_uncertain: Current E16 integrated replay stores task-family/operand tuples, re-renders prompts and computes arithmetic targets; no evidence raw-byte replay can retain coverage yet.
shortlist.small_comparison: Only after outstanding E16-WR work is resolved: same bytes, gradient steps and target bytes, compare raw contiguous replay vs structured replay with frozen targets from past actual events, and a matched model-generated target arm. Record target correctness and diversity. No new learner changes here.
shortlist.control: Identical buffer byte budget, chronological exposure and stored next-byte targets; same model and teacher access.
shortlist.reject_if: Any apparent benefit disappears after equal target correctness or requires hidden task IDs/labels.
shortlist.resource_cost: Raw replay buffer O(B·L) bytes plus sampling O(B); per-family semantic index removal saves parser but may require many more bytes. Measure realized distinct coverage, not arbitrary parameter counts.

shortlist.name: Sensory re-anchoring
shortlist.observed_limitation: E16 format switches could change address geometry but current evidence also implicates replay quality.
shortlist.new_capability: Adapt input-to-stable-coordinate map while preserving a learned downstream task circuit.
shortlist.missing_or_uncertain: No verified lifetime byte re-anchoring in pinned repo; CX fitted gains and location anchoring are different experiment lineages.
shortlist.small_comparison: Provide only observable co-occurring equivalents or temporally contiguous view changes, freeze downstream trained rule, compare local afferent reanchoring with a parameter-matched generic adapter. Evaluate both representation alignment and old/new exact task accuracy.
shortlist.control: Adapter with identical input correspondences, writable synapses, update steps and replay budget.
shortlist.reject_if: Representations align but old-rule accuracy does not recover, or gain depends on an oracle equivalence map absent from test information.
shortlist.resource_cost: S_anchor plastic weights plus S_anchor eligibility values if used, O(S_anchor) update work; correspondence memory accounted separately.

shortlist.name: Learned teaching transfer
shortlist.observed_limitation: Never-rewarded association chaining is related to composite generalization, but no evidence E16 lacks direct compositional machinery.
shortlist.new_capability: A learned cue can serve as a secondary reinforcer for a student compartment.
shortlist.missing_or_uncertain: Drosophila higher-order conditioning supports chaining, not general arithmetic rule induction; self-produced reward error may recursively amplify mistakes.
shortlist.small_comparison: Equal supervised reward exposure first-order+second-order associative chain, with held-out cue-to-cue links and teacher reliability manipulation; require internal teacher confidence derived causally.
shortlist.control: Equal-size two-association direct-delayed training with same first-order experiences, or replay of same observable cues without teacher feedback.
shortlist.reject_if: Transfer fails outside directly associated chains, or false teacher outputs rise without external outcome correction.
shortlist.resource_cost: S_teacher+S_student+S_feedback weights, plus K state and possible confidence statistics; requires causally observable verification not future labels.

shortlist.name: Parallel opposing memory traces
shortlist.observed_limitation: Potential revision/relapse and dormant recall; not the currently isolated format-switch cause.
shortlist.new_capability: Coexistence of contradictory valence information with context-sensitive expression.
shortlist.missing_or_uncertain: Published experiment shows opposing fly engrams; it does not establish two weight matrices outperform capacity-matched independent banks or that a selector can be learned without task IDs.
shortlist.small_comparison: Fixed total writable weights n and selector budget p, compare explicit +/− traces with generic n-weight two-bank variant on reversal and dormant return, with equal label/reward exposure.
shortlist.control: Matched generic two-store system with same memory bytes, selector, and read compute.
shortlist.reject_if: No improvement over equal-resource banks or selector needs privileged stage/obsolete flags.
shortlist.resource_cost: If each trace uses n weights: 2n plus p selector vs single n; for matched test hold total n_total and p fixed. O(n_total+p) per update/read.

shortlist.name: MBON–DAN reinforcement prediction-error feedback
shortlist.observed_limitation: Teaching/credit allocation matters, but supervised E16 cross-entropy gradient is not dopamine TD error and no reward stream is established.
shortlist.new_capability: Subtract expected reward from received reward through a learned teacher feedback loop in biological model.
shortlist.missing_or_uncertain: Bennett MATLAB code model checked at pinned commit, not reproduced; current network has dynamic sign-backprop and labeled targets but not this recurrent RPE computation.
shortlist.small_comparison: Only if a reinforcement/outcome-only environment is defined: compare model-implemented MB RPE feedback to same-state scalar supervised reward residual with matched outcome access.
shortlist.control: Same received-reward and predicted-reward inputs, weights, time and feedback dimensions.
shortlist.reject_if: No improved reward prediction/return or benefit requires giving teacher target answer bytes.
shortlist.resource_cost: KC-MBON weights S and MBON-DAN feedback S_fb plus modulatory states K; O(S+S_fb+K).
